translation: Took place in posad Serock, 12 July 1890, 11 AM. Appeared personally Szymla Kac[?], trader, 60, and Berek Koltun, laborer, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 11 PM in posad Serock died Dwojra Puszczyk[?], daughter of unknown parents, aged ninety years. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this [child - sic], this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us; the witnesses declared themselves illiterate.
